title.zh: 修复 21 天路由预检的真实失败传播

purpose.en: Fix the daily QA route preflight after its SmartCard Challenge checks returned false while the GitHub workflow incorrectly completed successfully.
purpose.zh: 修复每日 QA 路由预检：SmartCard Challenge 检查返回失败时，GitHub workflow 仍错误显示成功。

en: Recognize the server-rendered Challenge calendar heading used by every selected-language route.
Propagate the route checker's nonzero exit through tee so a failed artifact cannot produce a green workflow.
zh: 识别每个已选语言 Challenge 路由稳定服务端渲染的挑战日历标题。
让路由检查器的非零退出码穿透 tee，禁止失败 artifact 产生绿色 workflow。

en: Only the SmartLingo 21-day anonymous route preflight script, workflow failure semantics, contract tests, and release metadata change.
No learning data, score, authentication, payment, referral, certificate, production binding, or sibling-site behavior changes.
zh: 仅修改 SmartLingo 21 天匿名路由预检脚本、workflow 失败语义、合同测试与发布元数据。
不修改学习数据、成绩、身份验证、支付、推荐、证书、生产绑定或兄弟站点行为。

en: Replace post-fetch Challenge markers with stable SSR calendar copy while retaining HTTP, response-size, and marker requirements.
Enable Bash pipefail on the workflow route-check step and add regression assertions for both contracts.
zh: 将依赖后续数据加载的 Challenge 标记替换为稳定 SSR 日历文案，同时保留 HTTP、响应大小与标记要求。
在 workflow 路由检查步骤启用 Bash pipefail，并为两项合同新增回归断言。

en: Run the QA contract, production route preflight for 2026-08-25, complete repository release gate, sensitive-data scan, source-drift checks, and shared policy/architecture/base-feature/contracts gates.
Deploy through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, rerun the corrected daily route preflight, and verify the production Challenge route in the real Chrome acceptance session.
zh: 执行 QA 合同、2026-08-25 生产路由预检、全仓发布门禁、敏感信息扫描、源码漂移检查及共享政策/架构/基础功能/合同门禁。
通过 GitHub Actions 发布到 Cloudflare，重跑修正后的每日路由预检，并在真实 Chrome 验收中验证生产 Challenge 路由。

en: No functional scope is intentionally deferred; this anonymous preflight remains explicitly separate from signed-in learning evidence.
zh: 没有功能范围被有意延期；该匿名预检继续明确独立于登录学习证据。

en: Use SmartLingo's Chinese Challenge calendar copy and preserve the fixed four-language 21-day QA plan.
Preserve user-authored untracked files and the existing GitHub Actions to Cloudflare delivery boundary.
zh: 使用 SmartLingo 中文 Challenge 日历文案，并保持固定四语言的 21 天 QA 计划。
保留用户未跟踪文件及既有 GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 发布边界。
